name: Minnesota
status_why: The Secretary of State's results sites show this computer a CAPTCHA, so no program asks them for anything; John saves the Media Files by hand on the night and the updater reads the folder.
approval_note: John's answers of 2026-10-09 (Minnesota by hand) and 2026-10-10 (D3).
system: The Secretary of State's own results site and its Media Files: semicolon-separated text, one line per candidate per area, every level from U.S. Senator to hospital boards, with precinct lines.

results_page.label: Minnesota Secretary of State: election results
results_page.source: results_mn.json (a link for readers; never requested by a program)

other_pages.label: Minnesota Secretary of State: find your polling place
other_pages.note: a link for readers; never requested by a program

election.how_to_find: Files by date: the night's files go in states_cache/mn_local/sos/20261103/results/.

files: every text file on the election's Media Files page (any extension; each file is recognised by its first lines, never by its name)
hand.how: John saves the Media Files in his own browser every 15 to 30 minutes from about 8:15 p.m. until the counties finish, and once more in the morning. All the files in the folder are read together as one snapshot; a figure's time is when he saved the newest file, since the files state no time of their own.

feeds.what: every level: statewide, Congress, Legislature, courts, county, soil and water, city, township, school and hospital districts, by precinct
feeds.address: Media Files on the Secretary's results site (saved by John; never fetched)
feeds.updates: re-posted through the night as counties report
feeds.note: Radware CAPTCHA to this computer, in the Browser pane too (CLAUDE.md). Never requested.

feeds.what: past official precinct results (2012 to 2024), for rehearsals and the model; not live
feeds.address: Minnesota Geospatial Commons, us_mn_state_sos feature services (General Election Results By Precinct)
feeds.note: Read already by the ballot pages' past-vote figures.

local: Every level is in the Secretary's files; the counties publish nothing separate for live counts.
how_counted: Each precinct is reported once it is complete. The files give one total a precinct; absentee ballots are counted into their precincts, or into a county's absentee precinct where the county uses one.
count_order: Precincts arrive county by county as each finishes; there is no split by ballot type, so the order to learn is which counties and precincts report first, and when each county's last absentee ballots are added.

rules.applies: a contest where voters choose several ("Elect 2" in the office title)
rules.note: the top N candidates take the seats

certify.rule: The State Canvassing Board meets on the 16th day after the state general election; county canvassing boards meet between the third and eighth days after it (Minn. Stat. 204C.33).
certify.local_rule: County canvassing boards, Nov 6 to Nov 11, 2026.

never_why.*.sos.mn.gov: the Secretary of State's results, results files, candidates, main site and poll finder: a Radware CAPTCHA to this computer (CLAUDE.md); John saves the files himself

rehearsal: John's saved Media Files for the Aug 11, 2026 primary (20260811) and, if he can, the Nov 5, 2024 general (20241105); until then the fixture in election/fixtures/mn/ (the 2024 U.S. Senate count in three counties, from the Secretary's official precinct results).
terms: Not checked (the host is never requested).
scout_blocked: electionresults.sos.mn.gov, electionresultsfiles.sos.mn.gov, candidates.sos.mn.gov and www.sos.mn.gov: Radware CAPTCHA (CLAUDE.md).
scout_plan: Hand-fed: John saves the Media Files every 15 to 30 minutes; the updater reads the folder, checks each office's precinct lines against the file's own totals, and publishes.
notes: The results file layout is the Secretary's media file description as the kit and OpenElections' readers have it; it is confirmed only when John saves a real set of files (the Aug 11 primary's, by Oct 12).
